title: Game for the lord's table
The great hall's feast
summary: The lord of {settlement} gives a feast, and the steward needs {count} × {item} for the high table.
offer: His lordship has guests from three towns at the end of the week, and the huntsmen have brought in nothing but excuses. {count} × {item}, the best you can find.
complete: The feast will be talked of for a year. His lordship asks your name.
